name: Left 4 Dead
description: Left 4 Dead is a cooperative first-person shooter survival horror video game. Developed by Valve South, it was released for Microsoft Windows and Xbox 360 on November 18, 2008, and later for Mac OS X on October 5, 2010. The game is set in the immediate aftermath of a zombie apocalypse, following the journey of four survivors as they attempt to escape the overrun region of the Eastern United States. Left 4 Dead is known for its fast-paced gameplay, emphasis on teamwork, and the 'Director' AI system, which dynamically adjusts the game's difficulty and pacing based on the players' performance.
